## Purpose

Explain the defensive goal and the documentation or implementation changes.

## Authorized scope / research context

Provide the test environment and authorization context, if relevant. Do not include credentials or sensitive details.

## Validation

Explain how the changes were reviewed or tested. Separate proposed behavior from observed results.

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential logs included
- [ ] No unpatched vulnerability details included in this public PR
- [ ] Testing stayed within documented authorized scope

- [ ] Public claims are supported by reproducible evidence
